content:
Not every day brings a new Apple TV tvOS app. Shopify has just launched Shopcast, bringing a dashboard designed specifically for merchants to the big screen.

Shopcast's new app introduction reads: "Shopcast turns your Apple TV into a dashboard for your Shopify business. Track sales, discover your best-selling products, and see where orders are coming from — all displayed in a format designed for your office, retail space, or team room."

Let's take a look at Shopcast's screenshots:

Here are the details of the Shopcast TV app:

Get a clear overview of your business — view sales revenue, number of orders, items sold, and average order value. Explore order activity on an interactive globe. Track best-selling products and popular colours. Compare the performance of your online store and Shopify POS. Discover your busiest retail locations and source markets. Switch between multiple connected stores while keeping each store's data separate. Choose light or dark mode as needed.

Here is more from Shopify about this new business dashboard app:

Designed for Apple TV — browse views of revenue, overview, products, retail, and geographic distribution via the Apple TV remote. Dashboard totals update regularly to help your team stay on top of business performance throughout the day. Connect your store — connect your online store via Shopify authorisation. The data displayed depends on your account permissions. Shopcast is responsible for displaying your online store's activity; to manage products, orders, and settings, please continue to do so in Shopify. An existing Shopify store, authorised access, and an internet connection are required. Currently available in English only.

You can download Shopcast from the App Store on Apple TV. A change `end` of `string` looks like an excellent new way for merchants to make the most of Apple TV 4K.
